name: Aider Local AI Coding Assistant
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source terminal AI pair-programming tool with repository mapping, Git integration and code editing; run with your own Ollama/local models without an Aider software subscription or vendor-imposed message quota.
watch_out: No free hosted model credits are bundled. Local models require suitable RAM/GPU and may produce lower-quality edits; paid LLM APIs, compute and third-party services cost extra. Review each model's separate commercial license and security before granting file/command access.
